meaning: Finite registry of named runtime adjustments. Every quirk is adapter/port opt-in, off by default, and its condition is an observed capability or measured fact - CFW_NAME and DEVICE_NAME are logged facts, never sufficient conditions (portmaster contract device_info_rule).

quirks.condition: graphics: GPU family observed as Mali Utgard (mali-4xx) after context creation
quirks.effect: replace glFinish with glFlush on render-to-texture completion paths; the Utgard blob stalls the GPU and starves audio on per-RTT glFinish

quirks.condition: host: game assets streamed from FUSE-like or slow block storage
quirks.effect: enable block read-ahead for archive streaming

quirks.condition: host: process owns the console on a KMSDRM/evdev stack (SDL took the VT keyboard)
quirks.effect: restore KDSKBMODE/kbd_mode and reset the TTY before process exit so the device is not left with the keymap in K_OFF

quirks.condition: input: active SDL mapping does not deliver back and start buttons
quirks.effect: read BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY1/2 from evdev as an emergency SELECT+START exit chord, gated so it never fires when the mapping already declares back/start

quirks.condition: input: CFW mapping declares a guide button that collides with the firmware hotkey
quirks.effect: strip guide:bN from the inherited SDL mapping before use

quirks.condition: graphics: FULLSCREEN_DESKTOP produced a wrong-size drawable on the observed backend
quirks.effect: opt into exclusive fullscreen instead of desktop fullscreen; default stays desktop because exclusive modesets fail with EGL_BAD_MATCH on kmsdrm/wayland

quirks.condition: graphics: real context created but glGetString(GL_RENDERER) is empty - the versioned GLES/EGL SONAME resolves to a driverless Mesa while a Mali blob with the needed entry points exists behind the unversioned name
quirks.effect: re-execute the process with LD_PRELOAD pointing at the validated Mali blob (prefer an explicit GBM/DRM transport on direct backends, require the GLES1 entry points via dlsym, always refuse dummy/stub/headless providers, and refuse pure x11/wayland variants only when incompatible with the active backend; a hybrid wayland-gbm name remains eligible); healthy stacks incl. Panfrost report a renderer and are never touched

quirks.condition: graphics: a real SDL window, current context and positive drawable exist but GL_RENDERER is empty, while one transport-compatible provider object exports both EGL and the engine-required GLES entry points
quirks.effect: after complete video teardown, re-execute once with SDL_VIDEO_EGL_DRIVER and SDL_VIDEO_GL_DRIVER both bound to the exact same validated provider object; no CFW/device name selects the fix and a healthy renderer is never touched

quirks.condition: graphics: the EGL provider the dynamic linker resolved refuses the kernel driver before any window exists (eglInitialize fails, e.g. Mali user/kernel API mismatch such as user 10.6 vs kernel 11.7); the process would otherwise die at GL init with no context to measure
quirks.effect: after video teardown, prefilter alternate Mali provider objects by transport (the loaded provider is excluded; dummy/stub/headless always refused; pure x11/wayland refused only when incompatible with the active backend; hybrid wayland-gbm remains eligible), then perform a real eglGetDisplay+eglInitialize on each candidate; re-execute once with LD_PRELOAD pointing at the first candidate that initializes; if none initializes the original failure is left untouched

quirks.condition: graphics: scanout plane honours alpha (ARGB8888 KMSDRM) and the game leaves frames at alpha 0
quirks.effect: force the frame opaque immediately before present

quirks.condition: graphics: exclusive-fullscreen modeset yields a window that never reaches the panel
quirks.effect: use FULLSCREEN_DESKTOP and keep the firmware mode; exclusive stays an env escape

quirks.condition: graphics: measured tearing/latency on the observed present path
quirks.effect: glFinish before swap on the drivers where it was measured to help

quirks.condition: measured on this title: /dev/dri present and effective memory below 1.2 GiB made raw textures exceed the RAM budget
quirks.effect: force ETC1 textures without mipmaps on KMSDRM to keep RAM inside budget

quirks.condition: measured on this title: streamed textures at full resolution exceeded the observed memory budget (Horizon Chase carries its own equivalent as CUP_TEXHALF)
quirks.effect: halve streamed texture resolution above a floor (512px proven)

quirks.condition: measured on this title: sustained frame time above target on the observed GPU tier
quirks.effect: cap the engine choreographer to 30 fps

quirks.condition: audio: no session sound server observed, an .asoundrc exists at the login HOME, and the manifest home_mode is preserve (never applied with home_mode: port, which owns HOME)
quirks.effect: point HOME at the directory holding .asoundrc so firmware volume keys keep working (Knulli/Batocera)

quirks.condition: input: touch-driven menus need a pointer on a gamepad-only device
quirks.effect: provide a right-stick/analog menu cursor with a tap button (BC_CURSOR)

quirks.condition: lifecycle: the engine expects Android nativePause to drive its own save/pause on focus-out and exit
quirks.effect: route pause/exit through UnityPlayer.nativePause so the game saves (BC_PAUSE_NATIVE)

quirks.condition: jni: the game queries Google Play Games services that this offline port does not model
quirks.effect: return a live non-null Play Games stub so the engine does not hit a NullReference (BC_* nonnull)

quirks.condition: persistence: the v44 adapter must distinguish the one-argument and two-argument IL2CPP PlayerPrefs.GetString overload ABIs, including the hidden MethodInfo pointer, when a clean save has no value
quirks.effect: route each exact v44 RVA through its separately typed adapter hook and return a real managed empty string for a missing one-argument key (BC_PREFS_STRING_FIX)

quirks.condition: graphics: scanout plane honours alpha (ARGB8888 KMSDRM) and the game leaves frames at alpha 0
quirks.effect: force the frame opaque immediately before present (BC present-alpha)

quirks.condition: persistence: the on-disk progress/save format needs the port-specific parser to load correctly
quirks.effect: use the game-specific progress parser (BC_PROGRESS_FIX)

quirks.condition: graphics: the engine renderer needs an 8-bit stencil in the GLES2 config
quirks.effect: request depth24/stencil8 for the context (BC_FORCE_STENCIL)

quirks.condition: input: the v44 menu layer (FairyGUI) accepts only touch events; injected gamepad buttons are measured as ignored in the same panel where a touch at the same position acts
quirks.effect: bridge the right analog stick to a drawn pointer and synthesize a touch tap on R3 (BT_CURSOR)

quirks.condition: input: the pointer bridge is active and the port owner asked for the face button to click as well
quirks.effect: let the A button raise the same synthesized touch tap as R3 (BT_CLICK_A)

quirks.condition: input: v44 gameplay movement is read from the floating touch joystick the game draws under the finger, not from a gamepad axis
quirks.effect: turn the left analog stick and the D-pad into that finger inside the arena, releasing any pending UI touch before the finger goes down

quirks.condition: graphics: the floating touch joystick ring is meaningful only for a real finger and clutters a handheld screen
quirks.effect: keep the touch joystick fully functional while drawing its visual component transparent

quirks.condition: host: no Google Play services are present, so the v44 store review modal cannot be dismissed and leaves its dark mask stuck over the result screen
quirks.effect: follow the game's own native path (DBStyle.ReviewFlag) so the modal is never opened

quirks.condition: persistence: the v44 hall UI shows its native Progress button only when the Road bit of the Google profile is set, and no Google profile exists on this host
quirks.effect: restore that single profile bit so the game's own button appears

quirks.condition: persistence: the v44 adapter must serve both IL2CPP PlayerPrefs.GetString overloads and return the complete stored string, otherwise the autosave exists on disk but the Resume button disappears at boot
quirks.effect: route each exact v44 RVA through its separately typed adapter hook and return the full managed string with no length ceiling

quirks.condition: persistence: this Unity reuses apparently local String and byte[] references, so releasing JNI references globally kills nativeRender, while every autosave leaks tens of KiB
quirks.effect: keep a short ring of autosave payload generations and recycle only the generations already replaced

quirks.condition: input: the same stick must move the pointer outside a wave and the character inside it, and the context is decided by the game's own LevelMgr clock, GameStart state and top UI panel
quirks.effect: switch the left stick and D-pad role automatically from pointer to character and back, keeping the right stick as a pointer at all times

quirks.condition: input: the v44 pause is a UI button of a touch-only panel, so a gamepad START never reaches it
quirks.effect: make START tap the game's own pause button, and tap it again to leave the pause

quirks.condition: content: the owner's paid Abyssal Terrors expansion is gated behind a store entitlement query that cannot answer on a host without Google Play
quirks.effect: answer the game's own entitlement getters so the expansion the owner paid for is selectable

quirks.condition: content: the port owner asked for the locked-by-progress content to be available without replaying the whole progression on the handheld
quirks.effect: answer the game's own unlock predicates for characters, items and steps
